card.name: Colons and separators inside references and ratios
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a single character that joins parts of a compound reference, mainly the colon in epinephrine ratios like 1:200,000 and in section cross-references like WARNINGS: Captopril:. Also fires on odd characters in file paths and permission strings.

modes.label: Epinephrine ratio colon
modes.description: The colon or the digit after it in a dilution ratio such as 1:200,000 or 1:1000.

modes.label: Cross-reference colon
modes.description: The colon after a drug name or section title inside a see-section reference.

modes.label: Code and path characters
modes.description: A character inside a command-line file path or permission string.

card.plain: It fires on the colon or separator inside ratios and see-section references, such as 1:200,000 or WARNINGS: Captopril.
